properties.description:
User confirmed this implementation scope on 2026-10-20, with item 5 deferred and item 6 clarified below. Implementation is authorized.

Confirmed scope
1. Make Activity board selection update the Node editor near instantly in nominal use; reproduce the current delay before fixing it. [Earlier annotation 1]
2. Rename Planning identity to Activity board entry. [Earlier 2]
3. Use shared reference-value presentation everywhere, including component properties. Preserve each property's own header: name, help chip, type and Read only (when applicable) on one row, with the value below. Show Created by within Activity board entry and expose its eligible user/actor reference constraint. [Earlier 3, 4, 9; corrected by the user's latest annotation]
4. Make Parent task-only: Inputs cannot have a Parent, in the model, mutation operations or UI. [Earlier 5]
5. Deferred in full to the linked component-refinement task: annotation/comment content model and derived displayed title. Do not implement this item in this task.
6. Expose per-user Attention as a component. Each user's record stores the last acknowledgement timestamp and its disposition (Later or Acknowledged). No record means that user has never acknowledged the entry. Derive its group from that record and the entry's Updated at / Updated by: a newer change by another user makes it New; when the latest update is by the current user, it does not become New and may remain/go into Later according to the stored disposition. Preserve acknowledgement history rather than deleting it on entry changes. [Earlier 8 and user's clarified first-version rule]
7. Add Updated by for the last updater of the entry node as a whole, alongside node-level attribution/timestamps; it must not merely track one component. [Agreed refinement]
8. Use green in place of the blue board/panel header treatment to fit Broccoli. [Earlier 7]
9. Give New and Later independently scrolling content, keep both destinations available for dragging, and reserve at least one card-height drop slot when Later is empty. [Earlier 10, 11]
10. In the Node editor, scroll the Components content below its header. The header spans the full panel width, including above the scrollbar. [Latest annotation 2]
11. Disable spellcheck underlines in the Description editor so its content remains readable. Verify the source of the marks; do not assume they are validation errors or require changing global browser settings. [Latest annotation 3]

Delivery
Reproduce reported defects with persistent recorded output before production fixes. Verify affected behavior and inspect rendered UI under repository procedures. Include this task URL in implementation commits and report each covered annotation's result.

Separate work
Unresolved component-design questions, including earlier annotation 6, now belong only to:
http://localhost:43130/?template=personal&community=private&channel=99a62c14-535f-4d9a-9ab2-642ed280b795&space=99a62c14-535f-4d9a-9ab2-642ed280b795&area=timeline&node=graph%3A%2F%2Fplanning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b%2Fentries%2Fbc99553d-83c7-4945-b2c5-2ed757f1628e.json
The activity-type versus placement dropdown request (latest annotation 1) has its own queued task:
http://localhost:43130/?template=personal&community=private&channel=99a62c14-535f-4d9a-9ab2-642ed280b795&space=99a62c14-535f-4d9a-9ab2-642ed280b795&area=timeline&node=graph%3A%2F%2Fplanning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b%2Fentries%2Fe981411f-900a-422a-8ebc-6d77e337de1f.json
The Save and Task graph reports remain in their existing queued bugs. Latest annotations 4 and 5 requested this separation of the description and tasks.

Implementation and verification results — 2026-10-20
Committed in TheBroccoli: 97f2c1d (implementation), 574799c, e26980c, 885a8ef and d0b1910 (affected verification fixtures). Each commit carries this task URL. No new dependency was added.

Delivered scope
1. Removed the artificial 250 ms selection delay; card feedback is synchronous and a current inspection snapshot is reused on reselection. Recorded before/after discrepancies now match expected output.
2–3. Activity board entry is the displayed component name. Created by and Updated by appear inside it with the standard property header (name, help, eligible actor type and Read only), followed by the shared reference value below. Additional relations retain their separate relation-row layout.
4. Inputs reject Parent in the owner contract and mutations; only Tasks expose the parent relation.
5. Remains wholly deferred to the refinement task; annotation/comment/title ownership was not changed.
6–7. Attention exposes each user's acknowledgement timestamp, observed entry update and Later/Acknowledged disposition. No record means never acknowledged. Other-user edits return an observed entry to New; the current user's latest edit does not and preserves Later. Updated by covers whole-node and relation changes. Existing records with an unknown historical acknowledgement time do not receive an invented timestamp. New is derived, so obsolete Mark New controls were removed.
8–11. Green headers; independent grouped scrolling with empty drop space; Inputs can be dragged into Later; Components content scrolls below its full-width header; Description spellcheck is disabled.

Validation
- Build, organisation and final check:types passed: 1,061 authored files, zero type-safety violations.
- Model checkpoint: 41 passed. Focused planning checks: 30 passed. Shared suites: RelationalUi 251, WebComponent 33, ProjectTools 28, Testing 5 passed.
- Full browser command finished with 260 passed / 9 failed. All nine failures came from old fixture assumptions about self-authored entries appearing in New, plus the moved cross-field diagnostic. Those fixtures were corrected and every affected scenario passed in focused reruns. The original full-run exit remains failed; it is not represented as a pristine full-suite pass.
- Full npm run test:all stopped at Harness Node checks: 261 passed / 6 failed. One outdated composed-board grouping assertion was corrected and passed alone; the core worker passed all 6 tests in isolation. The remaining four Windows cancellation promptness failures reproduce the already queued reliability bug 916da876-ea04-42b3-ac05-93bba5129a8f; cancellation and descendant cleanup still succeeded. Exact new evidence is attached to that bug. Timing thresholds were not weakened.
- Inspected rendered screenshots for selection, Attention, relation rows, populated paging, empty Later slots, narrow editor, review placement and creation flows. Exact scoped recordings are attached as immutable evidence “Activity entry checkpoint 2026-10-20.json”; original before/after recordings remain in .harness/recordings/activity-entry-before and activity-entry-final.

Status
Implementation is committed; keep Verification open because the complete checkpoint is not clean. The app was restarted and its current editor tab reloaded on 2026-10-20; live UI now shows Activity board entry, Updated by and Attention with green headers. Before reload, the editable fields were compared with the saved record and matched.

Startup correction
The first restart rejected 11 pre-existing Contains relations targeting Inputs. The task-only Parent change had omitted this current-data cleanup. Used the preceding committed owner implementation to remove those relations atomically through its normal validated update operation (revision 783 → 784). Input nodes, descriptions and other relations were preserved. The current implementation then started successfully without any relaxed validation or compatibility code. Temporary recovery source was removed; exact affected identities and mutation receipt are retained in .harness/recordings/activity-entry-parent-cleanup.log.

Reference property header correction — 2026-10-20
User clarified that shared relation presentation applies to the value, not the property wrapper. Removed the SchemaField special case that hid normal property metadata. Committed as b541ad6 with this task URL. The unchanged implementation first failed the exact recorded header/value requirement; the corrected implementation matches it. Evidence: Reference property headers before and after.json (attached). Five focused browser scenarios and all 251 shared RelationalUi tests passed. npm run build passed, including organisation checks and 1,061 authored source files with zero type-safety violations. Reviewed screenshots and restarted the app; the live Created by and Updated by headers show the metadata on one row and Codex underneath. Editor values matched the saved record before reload. The full checkpoint was not rerun for this correction; the previously recorded checkpoint limitations still keep this task in Verification.
